items.source: type - required type of the non-unique bean
items.translation: type - 非唯一 Bean 的必需类型

items.source: beanNamesFound - the names of all matching beans (as a Collection)
items.translation: beanNamesFound - 所有匹配 bean 的名称（作为集合）

items.source: beanNamesFound - the names of all matching beans (as an array)
items.translation: beanNamesFound - 所有匹配 bean 的名称（作为数组）

items.source: Return the names of all beans found when only one matching bean was expected. Note that this may be null if not specified at construction time.
items.translation: 返回在仅预期找到一个匹配 Bean 时找到的所有 Bean 的名称。请注意，如果未在构造时指定，此值可能为 `null`。

items.source:
Return the number of beans found when only one matching bean was expected.
For a NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException, this will usually be higher than 1.
items.translation: 返回找到的 Bean 数量，而预期只有一个匹配的 Bean。对于 `NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException`，此值通常大于 1。

items.source: Exception thrown when a BeanFactory is asked for a bean instance for which multiple matching candidates have been found when only one matching bean was expected.
items.translation: 当请求一个 `BeanFactory` 的 Bean 实例时，如果预期只找到一个匹配的 Bean，但发现了多个匹配候选者，则抛出异常。

items.source: Return the names of all beans found when only one matching bean was expected.
items.translation: 返回仅预期找到一个匹配 Bean 时找到的所有 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Return the number of beans found when only one matching bean was expected.
items.translation: 返回找到的 Bean 数量，而预期只有一个匹配的 Bean。
